title: Glasses With a Chance of Delinquent
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Momose wants a quiet high school life free of troublemakers. Her gentle-looking classmate Ichikura, a boy in glasses, turns out to have been a notorious delinquent in junior high, and he still slips into fights while insisting he has changed. She keeps his secret as a shoujo romance grows between them.
life_message: People can leave a rough past behind, and trust and patience help them change.
